newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Min Xin buys 20 pct of China highway.
newsitem.headline: Min Xin buys 20 pct of China highway.

text.p: Min Xin Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it bought a 20 percent stake in the Zhangzhou section of China's National Highway number 319 for US$6.0 million.
The purchase, which yields a return of 16 percent, was sealed in a contract signed on April 14 with the Zhangzhou Highway Traffic Industrial Corp, the statement said.

"The National Highway number 319 is the passage between Xiamen and Chengdu. The Zhangzhou section is located at southern part of Fujian province, linking dynamic cities of Xiamen, Shangzhou and Quanzhou," it said.
"Anticipated growth in vehicle usage will thus provide stable income growth to the company," it said.
